title: The Most Expensive Team That Has Never Won Anything
primaryKeyword: san diego padres world series drought
audience: Baseball and sports-business readers who want a narrative feature on why the richest franchise sale in the sport's history belongs to a club that has never won anything.
metaDescription: San Diego just agreed to the richest sale in baseball history. The Padres have also never won a World Series. Those two facts belong to the same story.
angle: Long-form feature, not a chart brief: tell the record $3.9bn sale and the 57-year title drought as one story, using postseason scarcity, six seasons of payroll, the expansion peer group and the Seidler-era inheritance as evidence.

distribution.linkedinHook: The Padres just agreed to sell for $3.9bn, a record for a baseball club. They have never won a World Series. Those two facts are the same story.
distribution.shortFact: 28 years since the Padres' last pennant; about $1.5bn of payroll in the past six seasons; zero titles in 57 years.
